summary: DoubleDown Interactive Co., Ltd., a Seoul-based gaming company, furnished a Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim financial statements for the period ended September 30, 2026, including balance sheet, income statement and equity rollforward data in both USD and KRW. No transaction, ownership change, board recommendation, advisor, price, stake or regulatory clock is disclosed; the filing is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer (the non-US equivalent of a quarterly earnings filing). No special-situation event is present; watch only for ordinary operating trends and any subsequent disclosure of strategic activity.
